title: Enabling superior high-temperature capacitive performance in polymer dielectrics by multifunctional alternating nanolaminate coating
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2026, 19,3261-3270
DOI: 10.1039/D6EE00769D, Paper
Yuqi Liu, Jiufeng Dong, Kaixin Liu, Chengyuan Wang, Yujuan Niu, Liang Sun, Shuoyan Liu, Jiangyu Li, Jiannong Wang, Hong Wang
An alternating Al2O3/ZrO2 nanolaminate coating on polymers delivers a record discharged energy density of 8.50 J cm−3 with 96.4% efficiency at 150 °C via synergistic charge-injection blocking, deep trapping, and lateral electric field redistribution.
